ideas.title: Uncovering the Scope of Minnesota's Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of the child care fraud in Minnesota, focusing on the alleged $4M daycare with no kids and misspelled sign.
ideas.angle: Follow the money trail and identify key players involved in the alleged fraud.
questions: Who are the key players involved?
How did the alleged fraud occur?
What is the total amount of alleged fraud?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal a large-scale fraud scheme involving government funds and potentially corrupt individuals or organizations.

ideas.title: Impact of Child Care Fraud on Minnesota's Social Services
ideas.description: Examine the impact of the alleged child care fraud on Minnesota's social services and the community.
ideas.angle: Analyze the effects on vulnerable populations and the overall social service system.
questions: What are the short-term and long-term effects on the community?
How will this impact future social service programs?
ideas.insight: This story could highlight the need for improved oversight and accountability in social service programs.
